zh: 集成 Pro 全功能开源（PDF/Word/RTF/Markdown 等全文内容检索）
集成 Apple Vision 图像 OCR 离线文字秒级检索
全盘扫描支持与机器资产/构建缓存智能降噪
能效核心（E-Cores）低能耗调度与 80ms 动态休眠，彻底消除发热
FTS5 SQLite 批量事务提交，杜绝数据库与 WAL 体积膨胀
修复索引变动引发的界面列表闪烁
en: Fully integrated Pro features open source (full-text search for PDF, Word, RTF, Markdown, etc.)
Apple Vision offline image OCR text retrieval
Full-disk coverage with smart exclusions for machine assets and build caches
Energy-efficient scheduling on E-cores with 80ms sleep to eliminate heating
SQLite FTS5 batch transaction commits to prevent disk bloating
Anti-flicker debouncing for live index updates
